sources.title: Intent Analysis and Type Quotas | volcengine/OpenViking | Zread
sources.snippet: The intent-analysis prompt instructs the LLM to classify the user's task into one of three task archetypes — operational (action verbs), informational (knowledge-seeking), or conversational (small talk) — and then generate context-type combinations accordingly.

sources.title: GitHub - airockchip/rknn_model_zoo
sources.snippet: RKNN Model Zoo is developed based on the RKNPU SDK toolchain and provides deployment examples for current mainstream algorithms. Include the process of exporting the RKNN model and using Python API and CAPI to infer the RKNN model. Support RK3562, RK3566, RK3568, RK3576, RK3588 , RV1126B platforms. Limited support RV1103, RV1106 Support RV1109, RV1126, RK1808 platforms.

sources.snippet: A lightweight, high-performance API server for Rockchip NPUs (RKLLM), providing drop-in compatibility with OpenAI API, Claude API and Ollama API formats. This allows you to seamlessly integrate locally hosted large language models on Rockchip hardware with existing AI tools, frontends, and frameworks.
